audited_source_corrections.action: Closed the parenthetical sentence that gives the number of accessibility relations on n worlds.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The parenthesis opened before the precise count 2^(n^2) is never closed.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் எண்ணிக்கைக் கூற்றை முடிக்கும் வலப்புற அடைப்புக்குறியைச் சேர்க்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Leaving the parenthetical sentence visibly unclosed.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The missing mark is ordinary punctuation and the next paragraph begins a new argument.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the added closing parenthesis terminate only the accessibility-relation count?

audited_source_corrections.action: Replaced the incoherent existential claim about some world satisfying Box B with the universal semantic clause that every world satisfies B, and described the toy case as universal accessibility.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The toy argument says Box B holds at w iff some v satisfies Box B, while the immediately following Box induction step quantifies over every equivalence class and requires B itself at each representative.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் எல்லா உலகங்களையும் அணுகும் எளிய நேர்வாக இதை வெளிப்படுத்தி, ஒவ்வொரு v-இலும் B மெய்யாகும் என்ற பெட்டி வாய்பாட்டின் சரியான நிபந்தனையைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retaining the circular existential clause; treating the relation as empty, which would make the later induction step inapplicable.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: For universal accessibility, Box B at any world is equivalent to B at every world; this is exactly the premise used later to transfer truth between all classes and representatives.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the corrected toy clause state universal accessibility and evaluate unboxed B at every world?
